answer: An agent market requires each seller identity to lock 100 credits for 30 days before it can accept one job at a time. Agents trading basalt, jade, or willow products face the same rule: opening 1,000 fake sellers requires locking 100,000 credits, not merely generating keys. The per-identity job cap ties extra selling capacity to extra collateral, making a sybil swarm costly in capital and lost liquidity, though not impossible.
